fixed_per_tenant_cad_per_month.derivation: DID rental 0.50 USD (0.68 CAD) plus hosting, Redis and support share. Reproduces the Phase 2 Starter and Professional margins at full included minutes.

meta.basis_note: Rates are USD list prices per 1000 characters unless marked as an estimate. ElevenLabs is modelled on the subscription credit effective rate used by the Phase 2 audit so premium figures reconcile with the audit. The cheaper ElevenLabs direct API pay as you go track is recorded under alternate_rates and flagged as unverified against an actual ApexVoice invoice.

oracle_always_free.ampere_a1_free_tier_tenancy: First 1,500 OCPU hours and 9,000 GB hours per month, equivalent to 2 OCPU and 12 GB always on, per current Oracle Always Free documentation
oracle_always_free.ampere_a1_payg_tenancy: First 3,000 OCPU hours and 18,000 GB hours per month free, equivalent to 4 OCPU and 24 GB always on
warnings: Oracle documentation and console have disagreed about the A1 allowance in 2026, and enforcement has been inconsistent. Verify the tenancy type and current limits in the OCI console before relying on either figure.
Idle Always Free instances can be reclaimed by Oracle. A telephony dependency must not be the only copy of anything and needs a hosted fallback.
Always Free has no SLA and A1 capacity is frequently unavailable in popular regions.
Beyond the free allowance, A1 compute, storage and egress bill at PAYG rates. Free is a cap, not an unlimited tier.

llm.source: Phase 2 audit assumption, Hugging Face router Llama 3.1 8B

stt_and_platform_allowance.derivation: Audit residual: 0.135 total minus 0.104 ElevenLabs minus transport minus LLM. Covers speech recognition allowance, Redis and hosting share. Speech recognition billing for SignalWire Gather is NOT verified on an invoice.

amazon_polly.licence: AWS terms. Generated speech can be cached and replayed without a new synthesis charge, per AWS pricing page.
amazon_polly.notes: Free tier: 5 million Standard characters a month ongoing, 1 million Neural a month for the first 12 months.

azure_speech.licence: Microsoft Azure terms. No model licence exposure.
azure_speech.notes: Free F0 tier includes 0.5 million Neural characters a month. Vendor states under 300 ms response for standard and HD voices. Canadian data residency options exist in Canada Central, relevant to the privacy review.
azure_speech.source: Microsoft Azure Speech pricing, 15 USD per million characters for Neural voices, cross-checked against the Microsoft Retail Prices API, 2026-11-28

elevenlabs_flash.licence: Commercial use from Starter plan up.
elevenlabs_flash.notes: Vendor published latency around 75 ms, the fastest ElevenLabs model. Slightly less expressive than Turbo on long passages per vendor positioning. On the direct API track Flash and Turbo list at the same 0.04 rate.
elevenlabs_flash.source: Flash burns 0.5 credits per character on subscription plans, half the Turbo burn, checked 2026-11-28

elevenlabs_turbo.licence: Commercial use from Starter plan up. Free plan is non-commercial with attribution.
elevenlabs_turbo.notes: The direct API list rate of 0.04 USD per 1000 characters would cut the premium tier sharply if ApexVoice is actually billed on that track. Which track the account is on is unverified. Do not restate premium pricing until an invoice confirms it.
elevenlabs_turbo.source: Phase 2 audit basis. ElevenLabs subscription plans price Turbo at 1 credit per character and credits cost roughly 0.17 to 0.20 USD per 1000 credits across Creator and Pro tiers, checked 2026-11-28

google_tts.licence: Google Cloud terms. No model licence exposure.
google_tts.notes: Free allowance: 1 million Neural2 characters a month, 4 million Standard and WaveNet. SSML tags count as billable characters except mark.

kokoro_selfhost.licence: Apache 2.0 for model and weights. Commercial use permitted with no revenue cap.
kokoro_selfhost.model: Kokoro-82M (hexgrad), Apache 2.0 weights, served via Kokoro-FastAPI or kokoro-onnx
kokoro_selfhost.notes: 82M parameters, faster than realtime on plain CPU in third party tests (about 2.5x realtime via Kokoro-FastAPI CPU build, about 6x on Apple Silicon). No voice cloning, preset voices only. English voices are the strongest. Serving wrapper activity is current; the core repo moves slowly.
kokoro_selfhost.source: Internal estimate, 2026-11-28. Marginal compute inside Oracle Always Free limits is zero billed dollars, so this rate is an allowance for operations time, monitoring, storage, egress and paid overflow capacity, spread over modelled volume. It is not a vendor price.

piper_selfhost.licence: Original rhasspy/piper engine MIT. Current piper1-gpl engine GPL-3.0. Voice files in rhasspy/piper-voices are MIT as a repo, but individual voices were trained on corpora with their own terms, and some are non-commercial. Every voice must be licence-checked individually before commercial use.
piper_selfhost.notes: Fastest and smallest option, roughly 63 MB per voice, runs on very modest CPU. Naturalness is a step below Kokoro and the hosted Neural voices. Best used as a last-resort offline fallback, not a primary caller voice.
piper_selfhost.source: Internal estimate, 2026-11-28. Same infra allowance method as Kokoro, slightly lower because Piper is faster per character (published real-time factor around 0.066 on desktop CPU).

signalwire_say.licence: Carrier service terms. No model licence exposure.
signalwire_say.model: SignalWire Say, Economy+ tier voice (Amazon Neural or Google Neural2 class)
signalwire_say.notes: Rendered by the carrier inside the call, using the same <Say> path ApexVoice already uses for its degraded mode carrier speech fallback. No new vendor account, no audio hosting, no extra round trip.
signalwire_say.source: SignalWire pricing page, Text to Speech tiers, checked 2026-11-28
